instruction: Write toc.py: reads doc.md, writes toc.txt listing every ATX heading (#, ##, ###...) as '<depth>. <title>' where depth = number of # chars, title = heading text. Skip fenced code blocks. Run it.
setup:
cat > doc.md <<'EOF'
# Title
intro
## Install
```
# not a heading
```
### Deep
## Usage
EOF

grader.script:
python3 toc.py && printf '1. Title
2. Install
3. Deep
2. Usage
' | diff - toc.txt

oracle.script:
cat > toc.py <<'EOF'
import re
out, fence = [], False
for ln in open('doc.md'):
    if ln.strip().startswith('```'):
        fence = not fence
        continue
    if fence:
        continue
    m = re.match(r'^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)', ln)
    if m:
        out.append(f'{len(m.group(1))}. {m.group(2).strip()}')
open('toc.txt','w').write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')
EOF
python3 toc.py
